The Arab League Secretary General who sponsored the first Arab Creativity Oscar was **Amr Moussa**, who held the post from 2001 to 2011. The shared note's description matches Moussa's tenure, not Ahmed Aboul Gheit's (2016–2024), so I'm not adopting Aboul Gheit as the answer. I haven't re-checked this against primary sources in this session, so it still rests on the earlier search snippets.

CONFIDENCE: 70
